choices.question: What is the biggest advantage of working in a group instead of by yourself?
answers:
You can share ideas, split tasks to work faster, and help each other find mistakes.

You can finish the project without talking to anyone.

One person does all the coding while the others rest.

You don't need to plan anything because the group will automatically know what to do.

choices.question: How did planning help your team work well together?
answers:
It made sure everyone knew exactly what their task was and tracked progress.

It allowed the group to skip the testing phase of the game.

It helped the group decide who the boss of the project was.

It made the project take much longer than it should have.

choices.question: How is the “Hats” method useful for testing our game
answers:
It makes us look at our project from different perspectives, like checking for bugs, creativity, and emotions.

It helps us choose which costume our sprite should wear in the game.

It is a secret code used to increase the speed of game development by assigning each team member a single task and not discussing.

It makes a project completely perfect by continually reviewing the game from the planning phase onwards.

choices.question: What do we do when our team is "brainstorming" ideas for a new game?
answers:
We share lots of different ideas together without worrying if they are good or bad.

We pick the first idea someone says and start coding immediately.

We work in silence and write our thoughts down, sharing with the team when a storyline has emerged. Then we decide which idea would have been best.
